name: proyecto-final-starter
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y postgresql-client && sudo install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings && curl -fsSL https://get.opentofu.org/gpg/opentofu.gpg | sudo tee /etc/apt/keyrings/opentofu.gpg >/dev/null && curl -fsSL https://get.opentofu.org/repositories/opentofu.apt | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/opentofu.list >/dev/null && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y tofu && python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
